Identify any role, privilege, sharing, workspace, group, bypass, or callee condition only when visible in source, and report the exact failure behavior otherwise.

For any CRITICAL or HIGH finding, propose a concrete before/after patch for human review without applying it; discard or downgrade unsubstantiated findings.
